subject: W4 spine now walkable and self-disclosing; four PRs merged; Identity/Praxis both blocked by the same missing navigation records
result: MERGED THIS RUN: #240 5.1 Preview (d374d6d), #243 Compose becomes the ten-step spine (827c906), #244 Continuity reads real SessionSpaces with a SessionSpaceRoster Observed|Unreadable so a failed discover is not an empty roster (f42b705), #245 the spine becomes walkable and each step discloses its own detail (f18103b). VERIFIED BOUNDARY FACT, extending the owner correction: the TUI navigation index installs only Project, Host and Capability resources (crates/aikit-tui/src/backend.rs navigation_index), plus SessionSpace, workspace Surface destinations and Explain/History actions. ResourceKind has Agent, Profile and SkillSet variants but NOTHING installs records of those kinds. So Identity cannot become an Agent picker and Praxis cannot become a Profile/SkillSet/Skill/Method picker for the SAME reason — not a praxis-specific gap. Identity is therefore already complete at this boundary: world.actor_runtime.agent requested/effective is its only source and the spine reports all of it. Any further movement on Identity or Praxis requires new application-boundary plumbing, not TUI work. SHAPE NOW ON MAIN: ComposeStep (10, spec order, clamped movement) x StepStanding (Determined|Open|NotExposed) with distinct marks in both glyph sets; TuiState.compose_step beside workspace_section (NOT a second selection — walking the spine leaves `selected` untouched, surface-tested); Alt+Up/Down walks the spine as Alt+Left/Right crosses sections; each step in hand discloses detail from a read model already in WorkspaceReading; the three unexposed steps disclose WHICH contract is missing rather than showing an empty pane. WorkspaceReading { world, session_spaces } is the render input; add further owner read models there rather than growing parameters. REMOVED, deliberately: the four ComposeHorizon count rows and the duplicated selected-Resource intent/effective block — the latter is already carried by the wide-shell Inspector column and the `:` Explain overlay, and the duplicate was what pushed the step in hand off the pane. availability_label is now pub(crate) and shared between compose_preview and compose_spine so Unresolved-vs-Unavailable cannot drift apart in two renderings. STANDING TEST DISCIPLINE, learned three times now: the Compose and preview panes wrap, so rendered-buffer assertions hold only for row labels and short first-token strings; exact content goes in unit tests. The whole-buffer ASCII guard caught a § and two em dashes in user-visible prose this run — keep every mark and keycap hint going through Glyphs. REMAINING ACTIONABLE AT THIS BOUNDARY: Governance, Information, Worlds/bounds and Runtime can each deepen from disclosure into selection; W5 stays blocked on #227; W10 physical proving remains entirely unrun.
